thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: inference-queue-saturation (service: inference-queue) — queue depth spiked and autoscaler did not add nodes. PD link: https://pagerduty.example/alerts/PD12345

pagerduty: page fired -> escalation level 1

nora_oncall: ack. jumping in, looking at autoscaler/controller and queue metrics now

marta_sre: quick snapshot: scale-controller backoff + cloud API errors. kube events show repeated failures provisioning nodes: 'InsufficientResource'

alex_infra: Confirming cloud error. API returned quotaExceeded for GPUs in us-west-2. Raw error:
```
ERROR: quotaExceeded: requested 4 GPUs, available 0
```

alex_infra: I opened a quota ticket with cloud support (TCK-9876). ETA from support ~30-45m. Trying a fallback path (spawn spot nodes in us-east-1)

nora_oncall: customer impact? any 5xx/429 spikes? which tenants affected?

li_support: We see a 2% spike in 429s in the past 5m concentrated to a handful of high-throughput tenants (ids: T-44, T-212). Median generation latency for queued requests rose from ~120ms -> ~1.2s; tail much worse. Support preparing a short status update draft.

marta_sre: mitigation plan (short):
1) reduce batcher max size to lower queue pressure temporarily
2) manual spin-up of fallback pool in different region (spot or on-demand)
3) apply prefix-cache bypass and prioritize high-SLA tenants

nora_oncall: executing step 1 now: `kubectl -n inference set env deployment/batcher BATCH_MAX=8` — patch applied

devex_bot: Deploy accepted: batcher config change rolled to 60% canary (commit cf3a9e)

nora_oncall: monitoring metrics — queue depth dropping a bit but still above threshold. Proceeding with manual spin-up of fallback nodes. Alex, please confirm spawn command and whether IAM role has permissions.

alex_infra: running: `infractl pool create --region us-east-1 --type g4dn.xlarge --count 6 --label fallback-spot` — starting. IAM role check passed, launching instances now. I'll report when nodes BecomeReady.

marta_sre: I'll also add a temporary routing rule to prefer us-east for new requests to shed the hot cell: `routing.policy=region_preference(us-east):10` — deploying as a low-risk change

li_support: status page update queued: "Degraded performance for some inference requests; mitigation in progress." Customer comms draft posted to #support-drafts for review.

nora_oncall: if quota isn't fixed once cloud support responds, next step is escalate to infra lead and consider rate-limiting non-critical routes and throttling low-tier tenants to protect SLAs for paid customers

pagerduty: ACK from nora_oncall. Escalation paused until autoscaler behaviour verified

incident-bot: Update: fallback pool nodes registering (3/6 Ready). Queue length trending down (30% reduction in 10m). Keeping thread open for handoff and postmortem notes.

nora_oncall: handing to marta_sre for overnight watch. Leaving runbook: monitor PD alerts, queue depth, 429 rate, and cloud quota ticket status. If any regression, escalate to oncall infra lead @alex_infra.

marta_sre: taking over. Notes added to incident-runbook: follow up with cloud support re: quota root cause, revert BATCH_MAX after stabilization, document time-to-recover and mitigation steps for postmortem.

li_support: I'll follow up with affected customers in the morning if there's residual impact :support-ops:
